pilot_branch_rule: Full only if equal-weight geometric mean CPU result-ready time improves >=3% versus both B0 and frozen B*. Otherwise 36-session negative confirmation.
primary_metric: CPU input-submit to GPU output-ready; includes online CPU planning and transfers; excludes diagnostic hash/readback, setup, model loading.
executor_calibration: Q bundle maximum 4 or 8 on identity and Morton; 2 fresh processes per scene, 128 frames/session, warmup >=256 frames and >=2 seconds.
method_calibration: After common K freeze, q=8/16 x alpha=.25/.5/1; 6 configurations, 2 fresh process repeats per scene.
calibration_metric: Geometric mean of scene/repeat session mean CPU times.
formal_order: Seeded base permutation per scene/track; cyclic shift by block. Negative 3-block Latin rotation.
capacity_claim: UNKNOWN unvalidated footprint; relative sampled-reuse heuristic only.
limitations: Reference upstream backend, not current fastest backend.
Captured-camera discrete replay; speed names refer to index strides.
